primary: Mean normalized W2 at t=0.25 and0.75; equal episode weighting
secondary: W2 in physical diameter nm for aerosol domains
uncertainty: Sample SD across the five seed means, each averaged across the two episodes; not uncertainty across atmospheric or traffic populations
aerosol_truth: Exact W2 against measured histograms, with the same uniform-within-log-bin assumption used by preparation
aerosol_endpoint_representation: Common endpoint-CDF Gaussian quadrature at four times the original order for all rollout/deterministic-teacher methods; native CSB retains its fitted quadrature
